{{Quote|It's a device of Chiss design. Totally dormant except when in hyperspace, a time when virtually no one thinks to do scans for such things. We've followed Bastion's movement from system to system with a great deal of interest.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kres'ten'tarthi]], to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="VotF" />}}
The '''Chiss homing beacon'''<ref name="Gamer 5" /> was a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] designed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="VotF" /> The beacon was reliable and required little energy. It utilized the domain of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] itself as a signal carrier. The transmission generated by a Chiss beacon could only be detected by the Chiss.<ref name="Gamer 5" />

Before his [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] installed a tiny Chiss beacon<ref name="Gamer 5" /> in a dummy file inside the central [[Imperial records library|Imperial Records Library]], to allow the [[Empire of the Hand]] to track the location of the secret Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Bastion (code name)|Bastion]].<ref name="VotF" />
